facts.business: Mangalam Seeds Limited is engaged in the production and processing of commercial agricultural seeds (grain, oil, spice, pulse, fiber, fodder, vegetable, and hybrid seeds) and real estate development including residential, commercial, and mixed-use projects.
key_risks: Dependency on external factors like climate and weather conditions
Hybrid seeds costlier than natural seeds; farmer preference for natural seeds
Changes in government policies and regulations
No entry barriers leading to threat of new entrants
Changes in government regulations and compliance requirements
Fluctuations in market demand for real estate
Possible delays in project completion due to approvals or construction issues
